heading: Certification of treatment of payments under other laws
lead: Compensation or benefits provided to an individual under this subchapter—

tree.text: shall be treated for purposes of the internal revenue laws of the United States as damages for human suffering; and
shall not be included as income or resources for purposes of determining eligibility to receive benefits described in section 3803(c)(2)(C) of title 31 or the amount of such benefits.
